title: I2S slave transmitter and receiver: 16-bit samples, left and right channels, Philips timing (MSB one BCLK after LRCK)
features: I2S (Philips) slave: BCLK and LRCK come from the master; LRCK = 0 is the left channel.
`DW`-bit (default 16) samples, MSB first, one BCLK after each LRCK transition; slots longer than `DW` bits are padded (TX sends 0, RX ignores the extra bits).
Separate sample registers TX_LEFT, TX_RIGHT, RX_LEFT and RX_RIGHT; SDOUT shifts on BCLK falling edges and SDIN is sampled on rising edges.
BCLK, LRCK and SDIN are synchronised to the system clock.
Interrupt FRAME on every LRCK transition (frame sync, twice per stereo frame).

words.name: TX_LEFT
words.desc: Left sample sent in each left slot (write-only)

words.name: TX_RIGHT
words.desc: Right sample sent in each right slot (write-only)

notes: bclk, lrck, sdin and sdout are the I2S pins; they pass through unchanged. BCLK and LRCK are sampled on clk: each BCLK phase must last at least two clocks.
